inputs.text: [curious] off… THAL… moh… SOR… us. [pauses] Two pieces, both Greek. "Ophthalmo" means eye — like an ophthalmologist, [serious] the doctor who checks your eyes.
[warmly] The whole name, yes. He lived in the shallow seas of Europe and North America, [amazed] a hundred fifty million years ago, [pauses] with Liopleurodon prowling close by.
